prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Create one finished SQUARE illustration of the SAME BROWSER-WINDOW OBJECT CHARACTER as input image 1, in a new pose for an About-section circular portrait. Input image 1 is character-identity and art-style reference ONLY. Do not copy its microphone, stage performance, music notes, or any lettering.
Absolute user requirement: NO HUMANS, no human head, hair, skin, human torso or humanoid person. The character's body is itself a compact rectangular browser window with slightly rounded corners, a dark narrow browser header and three round controls, a beveled dark outer edge and warm ivory screen. Its eyebrows, two individual pie-cut eyes and cheerful mouth are drawn directly on that screen. NO circular/oval face patch, mask, added panel or disc behind the features.
Pose and purpose: one object character, TWO HATS TOTAL. A soft dark artist's beret sits naturally on the top-left corner of its rectangular browser frame, partly above but not covering the three header controls. One attached black rubber-hose arm ends in a white glove tipping that beret. The other arm ends in a white glove holding one ribbed light-gray builder's hard hat beside the lower-right edge of its browser body. The hand clearly supports the hat from underneath. Exactly two arms, two hands, two small legs and two chunky black cartoon shoes; the legs emerge directly from the bottom of the browser window. A slightly jaunty side lean, engaged expressive eyebrows and a warm small open smile. Both eyes looking toward the viewer. No human body under the browser.
Give it life and crafted detail: fine bevel highlights and a few neat screws on the browser casing, subtle screen reflection that does not obscure the face, soft wool folds in the beret, convincing hard-hat ribs and brim, glove knuckle folds, shoe toe reflections, a soft grounding shadow and two faint floorboard lines. The surroundings otherwise remain light warm paper. Detail should describe materials, not become noise.
Composition requirement: this square will be cropped to a CIRCLE. Arrange the COMPLETE browser, beret, gloves, hard hat, legs and shoes INSIDE an invisible central circle of diameter 82 percent of the canvas. Make a compact, rounded overall silhouette: tipping glove near upper-left, held hard hat near middle-right, feet near lower center. Comfortable margin everywhere. Do not draw the circle, border, decorative ring or typography.
Art style: lively 1930s rubber-hose cartoon, beautifully tapered hand-inked lines, rich black fills, neutral gray wash, warm ivory paper, subtle print texture. More dimensional material detail than a flat icon, not photorealistic or 3D. No letters, words, slogans, logos, watermark, third hat, extra character, props, microphone or detached limbs.
